abort.reconfigure_successful: Profile planning and routing configuration updated.

error.invalid_planning_policy: Select valid anchors and event handling choices.
error.invalid_route_provider: Select one provider, explicitly consent, and supply valid provider-specific endpoints, credentials, budgets, retries and cache retention.

user.title: Create a Mobility Forecast profile
user.description: Each profile is independent. Setup makes no provider request. Future hosted forecasting sends calendar location text to the selected geocoder and coordinates to the selected router only with explicit consent; it never falls back to another provider.

data_description.name: A display name for this independent forecast profile.
data_description.calendar_entity_ids: Select one or more calendars to read. Their order is preserved.
data_description.start_anchor_entity_id: Select the Home Assistant zone where a forecast day begins.
data_description.end_anchor_entity_id: Select the Home Assistant zone where a forecast day ends. This is independent from the start anchor.
data_description.physical_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude events classified as physical.
data_description.online_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude events classified as online.
data_description.all_day_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude all-day events.
data_description.no_location_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude physical events without a location. Online events never require a physical location.
data_description.route_provider: Recommended: hosted OpenRouteService sends text to its Pelias endpoint {ors_geocoding_endpoint} and coordinates to {ors_routing_endpoint}. Geoapify uses {geoapify_geocoding_endpoint} and {geoapify_routing_endpoint}. Google uses {google_geocoding_endpoint} and {google_routing_endpoint}. No provider fallback occurs.
data_description.route_provider_api_key: Required only for hosted OpenRouteService, Geoapify or Google. Hosted OpenRouteService uses this one user-supplied key for both its routing API and hosted Pelias geocoder. Stored as private Home Assistant configuration and excluded from diagnostics.
data_description.routing_base_url: Required only for self-hosted mode. Coordinates are sent only to the configured routing base URL followed by /v2/directions/driving-car. ORS is not assumed to provide geocoding.
data_description.geocoder_provider: Required only for self-hosted mode. Select the separately operated Pelias, Photon or Nominatim service; self-hosted ORS does not bundle one.
data_description.geocoder_base_url: Required only for self-hosted mode. Calendar location text is sent only to the configured geocoder base URL followed by /v1/search for Pelias, /api for Photon or /search for Nominatim.
data_description.location_data_consent: Required acknowledgement that calendar location text goes to the selected geocoding endpoint and coordinates go to the selected routing endpoint. No automatic cross-provider or hosted/self-hosted fallback is allowed.
data_description.max_geocode_requests_per_refresh: Required hard per-profile budget from 1 to 50, including retries.
data_description.max_route_requests_per_refresh: Required hard per-profile budget from 1 to 100, including retries.
data_description.max_request_attempts: Required bound from 1 to 3 total attempts. Only typed rate-limit or transient failures may be retried.
data_description.request_timeout_seconds: Required timeout from 1 to 30 seconds for each provider attempt.
data_description.geocode_cache_retention_hours: Required retention from 1 to 720 hours. Future cache keys use a profile-local HMAC and retain no raw calendar location text.
data_description.route_cache_fresh_hours: Required fresh retention from 1 to 24 hours. Route cache keys retain no raw coordinates or endpoint identifiers.
data_description.route_cache_stale_hours: Required maximum retention from the fresh age through 720 hours. Stale data must remain explicitly stale.
data_description.toll_policy: Explicitly allow or avoid toll roads.

reconfigure.title: Configure planning and routing
reconfigure.description: Choose anchors, event handling, one provider family, explicit location-data consent and bounded transport/cache policy. Calendar selection is preserved and reconfiguration makes no provider request.
